name: Scrapes Multi-Platform Community Data
what_it_does: Connects to YouTube, Skool, Twitter/X, and Reddit APIs to scrape, filter, and summarize tens of thousands of user comments and posts into structured pain point reports.

name: Generates Brand Identity & Logo Assets
what_it_does: Uses GPT Image 2 inside Codex to generate visual logos, color palettes, and typography guidelines based on natural language brand descriptions.

name: Simulates Buyer Persona Market Testing
what_it_does: Spawns multiple agent personas representing specific target demographics (CEO, Business Owner, Agency Owner) to evaluate brand messaging, headlines, and offer trust.

name: Plans Modular Software Architectures
what_it_does: Generates structured markdown build plans breaking full-stack applications into isolated git worktrees, slide specifications, database schemas, and API routes.

name: Executes Parallel Multi-Agent Code Generation
what_it_does: Orchestrates multiple coding sub-agents simultaneously across separate git worktrees to build auth, UI, API routes, and PDF generation modules in parallel.

name: Supports Remote CLI Session Management
what_it_does: Exposes active terminal coding sessions to a secure mobile web URL, allowing remote monitoring and prompting from smartphones.

name: Performs Computer Use Automated App QA
what_it_does: Controls a web browser via computer use to navigate local web applications, click buttons, input form data, test edge cases, and output visual bug reports.

name: Generates & Executes Postgres Database Migrations
what_it_does: Translates data requirements into SQL DDL migration scripts, copies them to the clipboard, and executes them in Supabase to create relational tables.

name: Audits Codebases Against OWASP ASVS Standards
what_it_does: Analyzes full application source code against the OWASP ASVS 5.0 benchmark to identify cross-tenant leaks, missing RLS policies, SQL injections, and SSRF flaws.

name: Manages Vercel CLI Deployments & Env Variables
what_it_does: Authenticates with Vercel CLI, links GitHub repositories, injects encrypted environment variables, and deploys production Next.js apps with custom SSL domains.

name: Processes End-to-End Auth & Stripe Sandbox Payments
what_it_does: Handles email signups via Supabase Auth, executes magic link confirmations, presents hosted Stripe Sandbox checkouts, and processes recurring subscription webhooks.
